nodes.observed: No formal difficulty grading (Parkland/Nassar) recorded during pre-dissection inspection.
nodes.guideline_action: Assess anatomical operative difficulty using Parkland or Nassar grading from initial pre-dissection inspection.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Proceed with dissection without formal difficulty assessment
nodes.source_quote: Assign Parkland grade from the pre-dissection view only

nodes.observed: Retraction technique not explicitly documented in verified claims.
nodes.guideline_action: Retract gallbladder fundus cephalad and infundibulum laterally to open and expose the hepatocystic triangle.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Retract infundibulum medially towards common bile duct
nodes.source_quote: Retract fundus cephalad and infundibulum laterally to expose hepatocystic triangle

nodes.observed: No dissection below Rouviere sulcus / R4U line noted.
nodes.guideline_action: Maintain dissection plane strictly anterior and superior to the R4U line (Rouviere sulcus to Segment 4 base).
nodes.recommended_alternative: Dissect posterior or inferior to Rouviere sulcus
nodes.source_quote: Dissect above the line from the base of Segment 4 to Rouvière sulcus

nodes.observed: Clipping performed with only 0 of 3 CVS criteria confirmed.
nodes.guideline_action: Perform a momentary pause before clipping to confirm all three CVS criteria (triangle cleared, lower plate exposed, two structures only).
nodes.recommended_alternative: Clip with one or zero criteria verified (blunder)
nodes.source_quote: Pause before clipping or transecting to confirm CVS

nodes.observed: CVS not reached by time threshold without documented imaging, senior consultation, or bailout.
nodes.guideline_action: If CVS cannot be achieved safely due to severe fibrosis or inflammation, obtain intraoperative imaging, call for second surgeon help, or prepare for bailout.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Continue forceful dissection in hepatocystic triangle
nodes.source_quote: Use intraoperative imaging or call for help when anatomy is uncertain

nodes.observed: No bailout indication or action documented.
nodes.guideline_action: Select subtotal cholecystectomy (fenestrating or reconstituting) rather than fundus-first total cholecystectomy when CVS cannot be achieved.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Fundus-first (dome-down) total cholecystectomy in severe inflammation
nodes.source_quote: Prefer subtotal over fundus-first total cholecystectomy when CVS cannot be achieved

nodes.observed: Cystic structures divided with 0/3 CVS criteria verified.
nodes.guideline_action: Apply occlusive clips and divide only the cystic duct and cystic artery after definitive CVS confirmation.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Clip prior to clearing the lower third of gallbladder off liver bed
nodes.source_quote: Use CVS to identify the cystic duct and artery before dividing

nodes.observed: Haemostasis / liver bed inspection phase not yet reached in clip.
nodes.guideline_action: Maintain dissection in the cystic plate plane off the liver bed and achieve complete haemostasis and bile leak inspection prior to extraction.
nodes.recommended_alternative: Inadvertent deep penetration into hepatic parenchyma
nodes.source_quote: Inspect the gallbladder fossa for bleeding and bile leak prior to completion
